visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a high-angle close-up shot of a large orange and white tabby cat, named Uni, lying face down on a person's lap. The person is wearing light pink striped loungewear. The cat is seen from behind, its thick orange fur covering most of the lap. A hand enters from the bottom to gently massage the cat's lower back. (2) The hand moves towards the cat's shoulders and front legs, which are stretched out forward. The cat slightly tilts its head to the left, showing its white ear tips. White text overlays appear in the center of the screen, providing context. The lighting is soft and natural, suggesting an indoor setting during the day. (3) The hand continues to probe and pinch the cat's shoulder area playfully, as if checking its muscle tone. The cat remains relatively passive, looking off-screen. More text pops up, labeling different 'muscles'. (4) Suddenly, the cat arches its spine and moves slightly forward, manifesting a minor display of annoyance as it shifts its position. A red anger emoji briefly appears. The hand continues to stroke the cat's back to soothe it. (5) The cat settles back down into a flat position. The hand provides long, slow strokes from the neck down to the tail. The video concludes with a humorous caption comparing the cat's shape to an insect.
